source: ambientCG (https://ambientcg.com), CC0, 2k JPG colour, DirectX normal and roughness maps
swap: To use other textures set a surface's "source" to "local" and put <surface>_color, <surface>_normal (DirectX) and <surface>_rough (.jpg or .png) in game/Content/ThirdParty/StuffTextures/, then run the SurfaceMaterials commandlet again. A stuff def names its surface in visual.surface (docs/design/building-draw.md).
fields: source: ambientcg or local. id: the texture's name on that site. tileMetres: metres one repeat covers. tint: multiplies the colour (sRGB, as picked in a paint program). saturation: 1 as it is, 0 grey. roughness: multiplies the roughness map. metallic: 0 stone or wood, 1 bare metal.
